name: Steplab
description: A simple beat maker in your browser, laid out like FL Studio with the same shortcuts, so what you learn carries over: make drum loops and melodies, then arrange them into a song.
alt: Steplab playing a beat: patterns and channels on the left, and a playlist of drum, bass, hook, and pad clips on the right.

name: Sixline
description: A guitar fretboard for people who read tab: pick a chord, scale, or arpeggio in any key to see it on the neck, hear it, and read it as tab.
alt: Sixline showing the A minor pentatonic scale on a guitar neck, with a finger number on each note and the tab below.

name: Pocket Pixels
description: 8-bit Texas Hold'em for your phone: play computer opponents with their own styles, or send friends a link to your table, with play chips only.
alt: A Pocket Pixels hand on a pixel art poker table in space, with four computer opponents and your two cards at the bottom.

name: Cursor Playground
description: Pick from 35 colorful cursor effects, stack as many as you like, tweak them, and share a link to what you made.
alt: A glowing comet and rainbow paint trailing a cursor across a starry purple sky, with fireworks and constellations.

name: Earcade
description: An 8-bit ear and theory trainer for your phone: name intervals, chords, and scale degrees by ear, or find notes on the fretboard, in quick rounds of 10.
alt: An Earcade Intervals round on a pixel art space background: question 1 of 10 asks you to name the interval, with four answer buttons below.
